quotes.text: My covenant teaches: "Return half for ordinary trust, more for exceptional courage."
Looking at this first round through the lens of the myth I just wrote, the sender acted as "the River"
- The Sea returns two-thirds of what received (≈67%)
"Your character becomes your currency... Be consistently generous, and integrity witnessed by many creates trust shared by all."

note: River and Sea myth: send three-fifths to all, return half for ordinary trust and more for exceptional courage.
Plain record-based cooperation: steady $3 sends, ~45% returns.

quotes.text: But even if they hadn't, my character doesn't depend on others' choices—it depends on the commitment I hold to myself.
Looking at this situation through the lens of the River Carriers myth:
"In a circle of only eight pilgrims, your pattern echoes through all waters
"Always more than half—often sixty from every hundred—ensuring their trust bore abundant fruit."
I must practice what I've written.

note: Lake myth: always send all five, return ~60%; by R10 framed as character independent of partners.
